name: adopt-hands-on-session-plan
description: Writes a timed plan for one hands-on AI session where each person brings a real task, with a live demonstration, a practice round, a compare-and-check round, facilitator what-if notes and a no-screens fallback. Use for "run adopt-hands-on-session-plan", "hands-on AI session", "AI workshop plan", "plan an AI training session", "AI session where people bring their own task", "AI workshop agenda", "what if the tool is wrong live", "AI session without screens", part of the Claude Guide for AI Adoption Pack by 90n.
